clues.text: In Aram, a young girl captured from Israel told her mistress a prophet in Samaria could cure her master's leprosy.
Elisha sent a messenger to tell this leper from Aram to wash himself seven times in the Jordan.
Angry at the prophet's word, he asked if Abanah and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, were not better than Israel's waters.
Healed at the Jordan, this Aramean went back to Elisha and declared there is no God in all the earth except in Israel.
When Elisha refused his gift, this Aramean asked to be given as much soil as a pair of mules could carry.
Elisha told his lying servant Gehazi that this Aramean's leprosy would cling to him and his descendants forever.
Jesus told a synagogue crowd that of all Israel's lepers in Elisha's time, only this Syrian was cleansed.

taken: Elisha told his servant Gehazi that this would cling to him and his descendants forever.
